paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: wisdom is something you go after with everything you've got. The writer says to seek it "like silver" and search it out "like hidden treasure" (Proverbs 2:4). Nobody stumbles onto buried treasure while scrolling their phone. But notice what the IFs are really asking for: an open ear, a heart pointed the right way, and a voice that calls out (Proverbs 2:2-3).

Now here's the part that should make you want to do a happy dance. You do the seeking, but the LORD is the one who gives the wisdom. "For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding" (Proverbs 2:6). He stores it up for the upright and is a shield to those who walk with integrity (Proverbs 2:7). So you never dig alone, friend. You just bring the shovel, and He fills the box!

And why dig at all? Because wisdom moves into your heart and then stands guard over you. "Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you" (Proverbs 2:11). It keeps you off the crooked paths and out of the dark, and it keeps you on the road of the good (Proverbs 2:12-13, 20). I spent years in the dark and trust me, you don't want to walk into it on purpose. So keep seeking, baker, and let the LORD do the giving.
